name: Builder — Idea Intake Cycle
description: Stage 2: ingest signals, score, build dossiers, fact-verify. Runs 4x/day. Replaces pipeline-guard.sh cron.

nodes.body_template:
You are the builder running the pipeline cycle.

The guard script output above tells you whether to run or skip.
- If STATUS:RECENT (and no URGENT items), complete immediately with {"skipped": true}.
- If STATUS:RECENT_BUT_URGENT, process the urgent board items only.
- If STATUS:DUE, run the full pipeline:

  PHASE 1: INGEST — Read ~/vault/ventures/signals/daily-scan.md
  PHASE 2: SCORE — Score each signal /25 (Pain,Freq,WTP,Comp,WhyNow)
  PHASE 3: DOSSIER — Write full 13-section dossier per idea to ~/vault/ventures/ideas/<slug>.md
  PHASE 3.5: VERIFY — Dispatch independent fact-check subagent for each dossier
  PHASE 4: UPDATE — Update ~/vault/ventures/portfolio.md and idea-bank.md

Rules:
- NEVER kill ideas. Score and rank only.
- NEVER grill or build. Those are separate cards.
- NEVER skip fact-verification.

Update marker: write epoch to ~/vault/ventures/.last-pipeline
Complete with {"dossiers_created": N, "skipped": false} when done.
